# kea_clientclass (Resource)

A Kea PXE client class (KeaClientClass CR) matching clients by test expression or architecture, with boot options.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kea_clientclass" "pxeclients" {
  name = "pxeclients"

  # Match legacy BIOS PXE clients by vendor-class-identifier.
  test = "substring(option[60].hex,0,9) == 'PXEClient'"

  next_server    = "192.0.2.1"
  boot_file_name = "ipxe.efi"
}

resource "kea_clientclass" "efi_x64" {
  name = "efi-x64"

  # Match by client architecture type instead of a test expression.
  arch_hex       = ["0007", "0009"]
  boot_file_name = "ipxe.efi"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Stable resource id (the KeaClientClass CR name).

### Optional

- `arch_hex` (List of String) Client architecture types (hex) to match. One of test or arch_hex is required.
- `boot_file_name` (String) PXE boot file name handed to matching clients.
- `cluster_ref` (String) Name of the KeaCluster this class belongs to.
- `next_server` (String) PXE next-server (siaddr / TFTP server) address.
- `option_data` (Attributes List) Extra DHCP options applied to matching clients. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--option_data))
- `server_hostname` (String) PXE server hostname (sname).
- `test` (String) Kea test expression selecting matching clients. One of test or arch_hex is required.

<a id="nestedatt--option_data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `option_data`

Required:

- `data` (String) Option value.

Optional:

- `code` (Number) Numeric option code.
- `name` (String) Option name.
- `space` (String) Option space.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a client class by its name.
terraform import kea_clientclass.pxeclients pxeclients
```
